response: STACKING PEAT FOR A STOVE IS A COMMON METHOD USED IN SOME LOCAL AREAS. IT INCLUES PLACING PEAT BLOOMS IN A SPECIFIC WAY TO HELP THE STOVE BURN MORE EFFICIENTLY. THE PEAT IS STOVED IN LAYERS THAT ARE ABOUT 1-2 INCHES THICK. THIS HELPING THE FUEL TO BURN MORE PROPERLY AND CLEANER. IT IS IMPORTANT TO MAKE SURE THE PEAT IS DRY AND FREE OF MOISTURE BEFORE USING IT. SOME LOCAL COMMUNITIES MAY HAVE THEIR OWN GUIDELINES FOR HOW TO STOVE PEAT.
